# Kunj Technologies

> Kunj Technologies is a website design and app development studio in Akola, Maharashtra, India, run by Darshan Jogi and Ayushi Jogi. It builds fast, mobile-first websites and business apps for local businesses. Websites start from ₹9,999 and most go live in 1–3 weeks. Domain, hosting and support are included for the first year.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://kunjtechnologies.in/): Overview of services, portfolio, pricing and FAQ on a single page
- [Our work](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#work): Live websites and apps built for local businesses
- [Services](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#services): Basic business sites, quote and enquiry sites, online ordering sites, business management apps
- [Pricing](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#pricing): Static plans from ₹9,999, dynamic plans with an admin panel from ₹19,999
- [FAQ](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#faq): Cost, timelines, mobile support, domain and hosting
- [Contact](https://kunjtechnologies.in/#contact): Enquiry form, WhatsApp and phone

## Selected work
- [Hair City Salon & Academy](https://hair-salon-web-ruddy.vercel.app/): Salon and academy website, Akola
- [Derma Care Skin, Hair & Laser Clinic](https://derma-web-gules.vercel.app/): Clinic website with online booking, Akola
- [Bakery Ordering & Admin System](https://baker-web-app-zeta.vercel.app/): Online ordering with admin panel
- [Kalyan Stone Crushing Industries](https://stone-crusher-web-gamma.vercel.app/): Quote and enquiry website
- [Heritage Lawns & Banquets](https://wedding-venue-web.vercel.app/): Wedding venue website
